ballPolicy: Keeg-specific separate ball follows the invisible far-side hand behind the shoulder, moves above and behind the complete hat, and releases on frame10/tick21. It is never painted into the poses.

review.reviewNotes: Fifteen distinct complete Keeg human reverse-dunk poses. The torso turns away; the separate ball travels behind the shoulder/hat and releases at frame10/tick21. The complete purple hat and mushrooms, black hair, close beard, adult anatomy and purple/lavender/silver uniform remain consistent. K.03 approves mirroring.
